retrievalProfile.description: A vertically split composition featuring two distinct group shots of the same subjects against a warm wood-grain background, separated by a central typographic bar.
triggerTerms: distressed brush lettering on black bar
excludeWhen: a single continuous image is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A dual-panel layout where two different poses of a five-member group are stacked vertically. The background is a consistent vertical-grain wood paneling. A thick black horizontal bar sits at the center, containing expressive, hand-painted style white lettering, while a smaller black box below it contains clean, spaced sans-serif text.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between the top and bottom group poses
High contrast between the black text blocks and the warm wood tones
Direct eye contact from subjects to the camera lens
Uniform lighting across both panels creating a cohesive single-object feel

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two groups of five men, waist-up, filling the width of each frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central black horizontal bar with white distressed lettering.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer starts at the top group, moves down to the central logo, then to the secondary title, and finally to the bottom group.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the subjects and wood grain fill the entire canvas.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the black bars and white text; natural saturation in skin tones and denim.
paletteRestrictions: Monochrome black and white for graphics

letterConstructionRules: Irregular baseline for a hand-painted feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: O characters are slightly squashed and irregular
E has varying horizontal bar lengths
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, textured display type paired with a clean, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the aggressive, hand-painted texture of the main title.
Matches the clean, modern geometric feel of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vertically split image with two different group poses of five men against a vertical-grain wood wall. Use direct flash lighting to create sharp shadows and high contrast.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a thick black horizontal bar across the center seam. Place distressed, white, hand-painted uppercase text inside it. Below that, add a smaller black rectangle with clean, wide-spaced white sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Are there two distinct group photos stacked?
Is the main text white on a black bar?
Is the subtitle text wide-tracked and clean?

adjustableVariables: Amount of distress on the main lettering
Height of the central black bar
mustRedesign: Specific faces of the band members

mustAchieve: Tactile, painterly quality to the main text
avoid: Clean, digital-looking fonts for the main title

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the black bars are perfectly horizontal.
Check that the wood grain is consistent across both panels.
Verify the text is legible despite the distressed texture.
Confirm the lighting style matches in both top and bottom frames.
recipe.reuseFormula: Vertical Split + Wood Panel + Central Black Bar + Distressed Type
